status: proposal from the 10-PDF pilot; no tables created
hierarchy: Project -> Document -> DocumentVersion -> Section -> Chunk; plus PlanActivity (rows of procurement-plan tables) and ContractEvidenceLink (contract <-> plan activity), kept apart from project-level NarrativeEvidence

fields: wds_version_type (e.g. Buff cover, Gray Cover, Final)

document_version.note: One WDS document = one stored file. For plans the WDS date is NOT the plan version date: the version date is read from the PDF ('Revised Plan Date(s)' in the STEP header). A plan PDF can join a textual part with an older date (e.g. 2017, 2018) to a newer STEP table export. A project can also have parallel plan streams per executing agency (P132833: Road Development Authority and MIHAPCLG), so versions are ordered within (project, plan_stream).
fields: text_layer (all pages text / pages without text)

contract_evidence_link.rule: verified and candidate/conflicting links are stored separately (two stores, same columns); a shared project_id never creates a link

narrative_evidence.rule: project-level only; PAD/ISR/ICR/ICRR in the pilot carry no contract references, so narrative is never linked to a specific contract

citation_format: {doc_type} {document_id} ({title}), page {physical_page} [printed {printed_page_label}], section '{section_path}', table {table_index} row {row_index}; source {source_url}; sha256 {sha256[:12]}
version_comparison: order plan versions by (project_id, plan_stream, plan_revised_date); compare plan_activity rows by package_reference_core across versions (status, amounts, planned/actual dates); ISR by isr_sequence
